title: GitHub Copilot AI Credit Usage by User (Estimated)

options.content:
## AI Credit Usage by User

**Important methodology note:** GitHub's Copilot billing API attributes AI credit cost at the **organization / model / SKU** level only -- it does **not** expose per-user cost. `github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_net_amount` and `github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_net_quantity` have no `user_login` label.

There is no exact way to map a dollar amount to an individual user from GitHub's API. What this dashboard provides instead:

1. **Actual, exact data** -- per-user, per-model prompt activity (`github_copilot_user_model_feature_prompt_count`), which is the real per-user signal GitHub does expose.
2. **Estimated cost attribution** -- org-level AI credit cost for a given model, allocated to each user in proportion to that user's share of total prompts for that model. This is a **proportional estimate**, not metered per-user billing, and is labeled as such in every relevant panel.

Use the estimate for relative comparison between users (who is driving cost), not as an exact chargeback figure.

panels.title: Top Users by Prompt Activity (All Models)
panels.description: Exact data: total prompt count per user across all models, for the selected time range.

panels.title: Per-User Prompt Share by Model
panels.description: Exact data: each user's prompt count per model, for the selected range. This is the basis for the proportional cost estimate below.

panels.title: Estimated AI Credit Cost by User (Proportional to Prompt Share)
panels.description: ESTIMATE, not metered billing. Computed as: (user's prompt count for model M / total prompts for model M across all users) x (org-level AI credit cost for model M). GitHub does not provide per-user billing -- this distributes the real org-level spend across users by their share of model usage.

targets.expr:
sum by (user_login) (
  (
    sum by (user_login, model) (sum_over_time(github_copilot_user_model_feature_prompt_count{enterprise="$enterprise"}[$__range]))
    /
    on (model) group_left() sum by (model) (sum_over_time(github_copilot_user_model_feature_prompt_count{enterprise="$enterprise"}[$__range]))
  )
  *
  on (model) group_left() sum by (model) (sum_over_time(github_copilot_billing_ai_credit_net_amount{enterprise="$enterprise"}[$__range]))
)

panels.title: Org-Level AI Credit Cost by Model (Source of Truth)
panels.description: The actual, exact cost data from GitHub billing -- shown here as the source the per-user estimate above is derived from.
